headline: Chef de Partie

skill_groups.label: Food safety
items: food safety checks and temperature logs

skill_groups.label: Communication
items: clear communication with suppliers and servers

summary: Chef de partie with five years in hotel and restaurant kitchens in Lucena and Batangas. I run the seafood and grill section, train commis cooks, and make sure every dish meets our food safety and quality standards. I also help plan banquet menus and service for events.

experience.title: Chef de Partie
experience.employer: Tayabas Bay Hotel and Convention Center
bullets: Run the seafood and grill section with two commis cooks for the restaurant and banquets.
Prepare mise en place and cook for up to 400 banquet guests.
Check temperatures, hygiene and allergen labelling in my section every shift.
Taste and inspect each dish before service and send back anything below standard.
Helped design a Quezon-themed seafood menu for weddings.

experience.title: Line Cook
bullets: Cooked grilled meat and seafood dishes on a busy à la carte line.
Kept the station clean and followed the restaurant's food safety plan.
